listings.name: Lyndoch Valley Butcher
listings.otherProducts: Sausages, mettwurst, salami, ham and bacon
listings.hoursAsStated: Monday to Friday 8am to 5:30pm, Saturday 8am to 1pm, closed Sunday.
listings.description: A butcher shop on the main road through Lyndoch in the southern Barossa selling fresh meat and house-made smallgoods.
listings.caveats: The Barossa Visitor Centre factsheet (July 2025) gives the same address and hours.

listings.name: Goodwood Quality Meats
listings.hoursAsStated: Monday to Friday 7am to 5:30pm, Saturday 7am to 12pm, Sunday closed.
listings.description: A suburban butcher shop on Goodwood Road in Adelaide's inner south selling fresh meat, sausages and smallgoods.
listings.caveats: Postcode not shown on the page. The home page still carries a Christmas/New Year trading notice from the 2025 holidays, with normal hours after that. Only beef is named in the text I could read; other meats are likely but not stated.

listings.name: Bos Taurus Butchery
listings.otherProducts: Dry-aged meats, meat trays and barbecue packs
listings.hoursAsStated: Mon to Wed 7am-6pm, Thu 7am-9pm, Fri 7am-6pm, Sat 7am-5pm, Sun 8am-5pm.
listings.description: A butcher shop in the Norwood Place shopping arcade on The Parade that also makes up meat trays and barbecue packs.
listings.caveats: Web search results showed business-for-sale listings for this shop (not opened); confirm it is still trading under this name. Only beef is named in the text I could read.

listings.name: Mathie's Meat Shoppe
listings.otherProducts: Sausages, bacon, ham, mettwurst and other smallgoods
listings.description: A butcher shop on the main road through Clare that sells fresh cuts alongside its own sausages and smallgoods.
listings.caveats: Sunday not mentioned on the page; treated as closed. Beef and pork not named in the text I could read (lamb and chicken appear in the shop specials).

listings.name: Fox's Chook House
listings.otherProducts: Turkey and game meats such as venison, goat and kangaroo
listings.hoursAsStated: Mount Gambier: Monday - Friday 7am - 5:30pm, Saturday 8am - 1pm; closed most public holidays.
listings.description: A Mount Gambier meat shop run by a qualified butcher that specialises in chicken, turkey and game meats.
listings.caveats: Specialist chicken and game shop rather than a general butcher; reviewer to decide fit. It also sells online with delivery. A second shop operates at 10 George Street, Millicent (Mon-Fri 10am-5:30pm, Sat 9am-12:30pm per the same page). The SA tourism listing shows different hours for Millicent, so I used the business's own page.

listings.name: McLoughlin Butchers
listings.otherProducts: Irish and European-style sausages, bacon, black pudding and smallgoods
listings.hoursAsStated: Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, Sat 8am-3pm, Sun closed, public holidays closed.
listings.description: A family-run butcher shop in Malaga known for Irish and European-style smallgoods made on site.
listings.caveats: Malaga is a light-industrial area and the business also does wholesale and online orders; the site has a retail section and City of Swan directory lists it, so walk-in retail appears to be offered.

listings.name: Fussy Meats Applecross
listings.otherProducts: Pies, sausage rolls and cooked foods
listings.description: A butcher shop on Canning Highway in Applecross that also sells its own pies and sausage rolls.
listings.caveats: The business has a second butcher shop at 86 Hammond Rd, Cockburn Central, and a pie shop in Yangebup (three outlets, under the chain limit). Poultry is described generally; chicken is named.

listings.name: Barbaro Bros Butchers
listings.otherProducts: Sausages, smallgoods, pies, duck and rabbit
listings.hoursAsStated: Monday to Friday 7:00am to 5:00pm, Saturday 7:00am to 1:00pm, Sunday closed.
listings.description: A family butcher shop in Greenwood in Perth's northern suburbs that also offers catering.

listings.name: Silvestro Butchers
listings.hoursAsStated: Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, Saturday 7am to 2pm, closed Sunday.
listings.description: A family-operated butcher shop in the Crystal Shopping Plaza on Main Street, Osborne Park, open since 2019.
listings.caveats: Also supplies cafes and restaurants wholesale.

listings.name: Spry's Meat Market
listings.otherProducts: Sausages, burgers, rissoles and meat packs
listings.description: A butcher shop in the town of Collie, inland from Bunbury, that sells fresh cuts and ready-made meat packs.
listings.caveats: Meats named via product and pack listings (rump steak, beef roast, lamb cutlets, chicken). Site footer copyright reads 2023; hours not dated.

listings.name: Ryan's Quality Meats Bunbury Outlet
listings.hoursAsStated: Bunbury Outlet: Sunday closed, Monday - Friday 8am to 5pm, Saturday 8am to 1pm.
listings.description: The Bunbury-area outlet of a WA family meat business, located in the Davenport light-industrial area.
listings.caveats: The business is a large food-service and wholesale supplier with two outlets (Jandakot and Bunbury). Confirm the Davenport outlet operates as a walk-in retail butcher before listing.
